digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and bug-fix review tier escalation
propositions: Explicit review-plan <bug> must escalate to full blocking rubric when ticket file_impact enumerates non-test paths, across both precheck and route_criteria seams plus batch-runner fan-in, while preserving light advisory tier for test-only or absent file_impact and keeping claim-time exemption intact.

Gerrit DET criterion must block oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, using cross-host opcert verification via trusted_env keyring and compute_validity freshness check.

Attestation verdict predicate must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head states, flag stale/malformed/unsigned/mismatch verdicts, and fail open (advisory only) for unavailable/error/unknown verdicts, with coverage test pinning exact verdict enum equality.
Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; 150-line threshold must be a single shared constant used by both B2 criterion and backtest script.

Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly 13 adjudicated-substantive commits with zero mechanical false positives, validating classification rule and threshold against hand-adjudicated corpus.
Debug-skill Phase-1-exit hook must invoke review-plan for non-trivial fixes, coordinated with ticket 78f1's writeback anchors.
